en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a European cityscape centered on a river, with bridges spanning the water and historic buildings lining both banks. The river flows through a valley, with mountains visible in the background. The architecture suggests a Central European style, with several multi-story buildings and a church steeple in the distance. There are people walking on the right side near the riverbank, and trees in the foreground.
